top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on flat, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Granfondo Bogotá's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before December.
53ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Road-specific control matters at UCI Granfondo Bogotá. Practice on flat: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 79 miles.
79 miles on flat burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Granfondo Bogotá. Train it until it feels boring.
At UCI Granfondo Bogotá, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Base fitness for UCI Granfondo Bogotá. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at UCI Granfondo Bogotá. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on flat can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,186ft of climbing on flat does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for UCI Granfondo Bogotá's 79 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: UCI Granfondo Bogotá includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at UCI Granfondo Bogotá rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on flat to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 79 miles of flat in Bogotá, Colombia.
